topic: The Venue Trap: Why Most Companies Pick the Wrong Space
hook: Most companies choose their event venue last — and that one mistake costs them everything.
script_he: רוב החברות בוחרות את הוונו אחרון — אחרי שהגדירו תכנית, תקציב, ותאריך. וזו הטעות הכי יקרה שתעשו. הוונו לא רק 'מחזיק' את האירוע — הוא יוצר אותו. הוא קובע את האנרגיה, את הזרימה, את מה שאנשים ירגישו שלוש שנים אחרי. ב-UPE, אחרי 1,500 אירועים ו-130 יעדים, אנחנו מתחילים תמיד מהוונו — ומבנים הכל סביבו. רוצים לדעת איך עושים את זה נכון? שלחו לנו DM ונספר לכם.
script_en: Most companies choose their venue last — after the agenda, the budget, the date are already locked. And that's the most expensive mistake you'll make. The venue doesn't just hold the event — it IS the event. It sets the energy, the flow, what people feel three years later. At UPE, after 1,500 events across 130+ destinations, we always start with the venue and build everything around it. Want to know how that changes everything? DM us.
captions: The venue ISN'T the last decision
It sets the energy. The flow. The memory.
Start here → build everything around it
post_caption:
Your venue isn't a container for your event — it IS your event. 🏛️ Most companies lock the date, the agenda, and the budget before they even think about space. Then they wonder why the energy felt off. After 1,500+ events and 130+ destinations, we do it the other way around — and it changes everything. 👇 Drop a 🔥 if you've made this mistake before.
